objective: 在Phase58完整36候选仍未达到PD histogram合同后，直接优化最终12-bin calls/bytes WAPE并联合约束TV/EMD；OOF未达标就持续生成下一轮候选，达到目标或约10小时总预算才停止。

dataset_contract.group_isolation: one profile and its six model rows stay in one fold
dataset_contract.final_input: low-dimensional causal history profile, model structure, fixed P1/D1 features and H0

predictor_contract.total_policy: preserve each H0 calls/bytes total; only redistribute mass across 12 bins
predictor_contract.shape_parameterization: softmax(log(smoothed H0 share) + bounded DNN residual)
predictor_contract.training_objective: smooth calls WAPE + smooth bytes WAPE + calls TV + calls normalized EMD

search_contract.runtime_policy: stop at first complete OOF contract pass; otherwise continue adaptive rounds until the rolling candidate-duration guard reaches the 9h search budget, then reserve about 1h for final fit and one-shot validation
search_contract.adaptive_signal: OOF-only worst metric, worst model, worst segment and safe per-bin signed bias; zero-target bins never divide by an epsilon denominator
search_contract.validation_rule: all architecture, loss weights, segment focus, alpha, blend weights and epochs freeze from OOF before validation is opened once

acceptance_gate.oof_protection: overall and every model/segment strictly beat H0 on calls histogram WAPE, bytes histogram WAPE, calls TV and normalized payload EMD
acceptance_gate.model_histogram: each of six models has calls and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.segment_histogram: each BurstGPT segment has calls and bytes histogram WAPE <= 0.15
acceptance_gate.total_wape: overall/model/segment calls and bytes total WAPE <= 0.05
acceptance_gate.next_phase_permitted: only when all OOF and one-shot development validation gates pass
acceptance_gate.negative_policy: if the time budget ends before the target, emit an honest negative result plus continuation_spec; never weaken thresholds or use validation/blind labels to continue the same search

stop_and_block_if: existing Phase59 result directory would be overwritten
claim_boundary: development-only evidence on frozen Phase48 compact six-model data
not fresh blind evidence or unseen-model generalization
not physical communication time, placement, latency, queueing, overlap or online scheduling
